story:
Sam has a big, blue ball. It is fun to play with. One day, Sam and his dog, Max, go to the park. "Come and play!" Sam says. Max runs fast to the ball. He can catch it! The ball goes up and down. Sam laughs. "You are funny, Max!" 

They find a tree in the park. Sam says, "Let’s sit down under the tree." They rest and drink water. "This is a good day," Sam says. Max barks. He is happy too. 

The sun is big and bright. Sam and Max play more. They can have fun all day!

prompt.system: You write very short stories for children learning to read. Use ONLY simple words. Prefer words from the provided Dolch list. Do not use markdown, titles, or bullet points. Output plain story text only.
prompt.user: Write a story of about 80-120 words for a first-grade reader. You MUST include several of these Dolch sight words naturally: a, and, big, blue, can, come, down, find, for, funny. Keep sentences short. No scary content.
